sections.text: Protection

Technical 
 Procedure

This procedure details the steps required to completely check 
 the proper operation and calibration of the fault locator SEL-49 relay. It is 
 recommended this procedure be carried out on an annually bases. This work be 
 carried out section of this document is divided into 3 sections.

The first preliminary steps to prepare for relay testing 
 describes the activities required prior to testing. Some of these steps could 
 be performed days before the actual test. The second section Preparation for 
 testing describes the steps to set up the equipment for performing the actual 
 tests. The third section is the actual test.

The document is formatted the way to minimize the possibility 
 of error causing personal injury or damage to equipment.

The first draft 
initialed & tested by eng. Abdel Azeem Anor, approved by general director of 
 Quality eng. Sameer Mohamed Atta.

items: A work permit must be issued

The maintenance staff should carry the suitable ID safety 
 category,

Maintenance 
 staff should be trained well, qualified or directly supervised by some one 
 who is.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.

Personal
 safety and healthy equipment must be used as safety shoes, safety helmet ... 
 etc
Permission between S/S and NECC to disconnect the line.
Make sure CT secondary are shorted at current test switch.
Make sure VT secondary are opened at voltage test switch.
Isolate DC supply to SEL 49 when maintenance on the SEL-49 and SEL data.

sections.text: Tools and Equipment
Preliminary Steps to Prepare for Relay Testing
Preparations
Testing Procedure(s)
Injection Test
Set up

Use list Designator "FF" to enter the following control
 parameters
Voltage Measurements

Press " START" to inject the test quantity. Use a multi-meter
 and verify that phase to neutral quantity being injected is =57-7 V and
 phase - phase quantity being injected is equal to 100 V Read the displays on
 the fault locator DTA Display unit and record them on the test sheets:
Current Measurements
Fault locator SEL-DTA Display unit should read:
Fault Measurements

Phase A to Ground Fault-Source at the Bus (No Source
Impedance Zs=0)

Change the fault code to 022 and change the current parameters as follow
 and keep voltage stay the same.
The Fault locator should read:

Repeat the test for A phase to Ground Fault with including source
 impedance after changing the following parameters:
 A phase -ground Fault (Source Z= 70.08-l261 of line pos. sequence impedance
 )

Repeat the Fault injection For B phase to C phase (line to Line fault)
 with the following parameters:
 B-C- Phase Fault. (Source Z=70.08 =1.261 of Line Pos. Sequence impedance)
Fault Impedance Measurment by ZZ Mode

Fault test may be also made without making calculation of voltages and
 current by ZZ mode:

FC 011, 012, or 013 for AG, BG or CG Fault 021, 022 or 023 for AB, BC, or
 CA Fault SQ 1F1 or 1F0
